metadata.description: Rajib Bahar's Claude Code plugins: staff-kit (engineering standards, skills, agents, guards) and market-watch (live market data in the session), plus vendored third-party plugins (threejs, cert-safari-quiz, evolv-taste-pilot).

plugins.name: staff-kit
plugins.description: Staff-level engineering standards: 37 skills, 19 model-routed agents, 12 commands, 19 rules, tiered contexts, and a destructive-ops guard hook. Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and cost-disciplined multi-agent work.

plugins.name: market-watch
plugins.description: Stock ticker in the status line, /quote pane, price alerts, a market-context band, and a quote tool the model can call.

plugins.name: threejs
plugins.description: Third-party (Tony Turner). Ten grounded three.js r185 skills: scene setup, glTF, materials/lighting, performance, picking, animation, post-processing, debugging, WebGPU/TSL.

plugins.name: cert-safari-quiz
plugins.description: Third-party (Tony Turner). CCA-F practice quiz: 100 scenario questions, confidence ratings, spaced repetition.

plugins.name: evolv-taste-pilot
plugins.description: Third-party (evolv Consulting, MIT). Executable frontend ship gate: 27 source checks and 9 rendered checks, with the taste-precedence overlay.
